item.title: You can't currently order a Tinybox with Nvidia GPUs — and Tiny Corp's new 192GB six-GPU AMD build just got $3,000 pricier
item.description: Less than two weeks after its $11,000 headline, the configurable deep learning workstation has dropped every Nvidia option and the tinybox pro, added two Radeon AI Pro R9700 builds, and raised their price.

item.title: Wendy’s store closures: Franchisee could close another 60 locations in Chapter 11 bankruptcy
item.description: Meratige Hospitality, which has already shuttered upwards of 90 Wendy’s restaurants, warned on Friday that more closures are likely. One of Wendy’s biggest franchisees is moving to potentially close as many as 60 restaurants, adding to the dozens of stores that it has already closed this year.

item.title: Watch out, YouTube — Instagram goes from short-form to 90-minute videos
item.description: After years in which every social platform (even LinkedIn!) aggressively pursued short-form video, this is a notable shift in strategy for Instagram.

item.title: Entrepreneurship might be the key to a longer life
item.description: It often means more work, but a new study found that freedom and autonomy can do wonders for your health. If you thought entrepreneurship was too stressful a path to venture down, you might want to reassess. A new study found that there may be a surprising benefit to starting a business: longevity.
